# Summary

The Palmer penguins data has **344 birds** of three species from three islands
near the Palmer Station in Antarctica. Body mass separates the species well,
see @fig-mass, and each island hosts a different mix, see @tbl-islands.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

penguins = sns.load_dataset("penguins").dropna()
```

::: {.callout-note}
Rows with missing measurements are dropped before every figure and table.
:::

# Body mass

```{python}
#| label: fig-mass
#| fig-cap: "Body mass by species, in grams"
sns.boxplot(data=penguins, x="species", y="body_mass_g", hue="sex")
```

Gentoo penguins are the heavy ones. Their median mass is
`{python} int(penguins.query("species == 'Gentoo'").body_mass_g.median())` g,
against `{python} int(penguins.query("species == 'Adelie'").body_mass_g.median())` g
for Adelie.

# Islands

```{python}
#| label: tbl-islands
#| tbl-cap: "Birds per species and island"
pd.crosstab(penguins.species, penguins.island)
```

Only Adelie penguins live on all three islands:

1. **Biscoe** has Adelie and Gentoo
2. **Dream** has Adelie and Chinstrap
3. **Torgersen** has Adelie alone

# Method

Measurements come from the [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/)
package, collected between 2007 and 2009. The flipper and bill measurements
are in millimetres, the body mass in grams:

| Measurement         | Unit | Range       |
|---------------------|------|-------------|
| Bill length         | mm   | 32 to 60    |
| Bill depth          | mm   | 13 to 22    |
| Flipper length      | mm   | 172 to 231  |
| Body mass           | g    | 2700 to 6300 |
